Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType The Rte_NvMNotifyJobFinished API shall return E_OK. Description The Rte_NvMNotifyJobFinished receives the notification from the NvM when a job is finished and forward it to the SW-C. Available via Rte_NvM.h
